Under legacy semantics, `"auto"` resolves to `"multiindex"`, so `flat_snapshots` is false (as it also is for explicit `"multiindex"`). `create_model` still obtains `sns` through the unchanged `as_index` call and passes that same index to the variable and constraint builders; the new context does not flatten component data when false. Changes within builders do not change which snapshots `create_model` hands them.
